fields.doubt: A principal ('Proposes an approach', intent.lisp) é clara. Decide se a secundária é 'Compares' ou 'Evaluates': as experiências opõem formatos de contexto e variantes do descritor a uma baseline Blind.
Decide se um descritor de arquitetura conta como especificação; o autor só o relaciona com spec-kit, Kiro e Self-Spec (p. 3). Se contar, a coevolução com o código (p. 2) aponta para spec-anchored.

fields.v: Exp. 1 (24 tasks, jarvis); agent/harness not stated + Claude Sonnet 4.6, temp 0, max 20 steps; criterion: correct localization, steps. Quality and cost verdicts for every entry: no criterion stated by the authors. (a) Blind + n.s. + Sonnet 4.6 (baseline): acc 54% (13/24), 5.2 steps. (b) S-expression context: 58%, 3.4 steps, d=0.92 vs blind (p=0.009). (c) JSON context: 58%, 3.4 steps, d=1.02. (d) Markdown context: 63%, 2.9 steps, d=1.43 (p=0.005). Comprehension study (20 questions, model not stated): 95% accuracy for S-expr, JSON, YAML and Markdown. Exp. E (15 tasks, jarvis-forge; agent and model not stated for this experiment): (e) Blind (baseline): 80%, 5.6 steps, censored mean 8.5. (f) AutoGen descriptor: 100%, 3.9 steps, censored 3.9 (p=0.002, d=1.04). (g) Curated descriptor: 87%, 2.9 steps, censored 5.2 (p=0.003). Writer side (model not stated, temp 0): parse validity JSON 100%, S-expr 95.8%, YAML 91.7%; overall error detection S-expr 50%, JSON 62%, YAML 21%, MD 0%; silent corruption 50/21/50/100%. Field study (Claude Code, model not stated): explore/edit IQR 2.24 -> 1.08 after descriptors introduced (observational, no control)
fields.why: Rule 1: the works / partly verdicts for accuracy and steps (and 'works' for the comprehension study) were the extractor's judgement; the study states no threshold for either, so each is 'no criterion stated by the authors'. All configurations and values kept
